artifacts.purpose: Immutable export scope, attempt inputs, raw and organized archives, media and manifests.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The selected complete archive, verified replay, or active incomplete-run recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the complete run with every manifest-listed byte; a fresh export is a new run if its immutable inputs differ.

retention_rule.rule: Keep selected deliverables and active or unresolved runs. Within a retained run preserve every manifest dependency, including earlier attempts. Retire a whole unneeded run only after all recovery, verification and downstream references end; do not prune individual files from a retained immutable run.

artifacts.purpose: A selected organized archive imported through the positional organizer.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Portable private archive and its INDEX.md.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore all manifest-listed files and their exact source bytes if a rebuild remains required.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only selected archives with a current deliverable or verification requirement; retire superseded copies after confirming no consumer still references them.

artifacts.purpose: Raw archive input retained for a selected standalone organized deliverable.
artifacts.producer: An authorized exporter or archive import.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The matching standalone organizer invocation and verification.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore exact source bytes and channel mapping; do not regenerate historical evidence from a different export.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only while a selected archive needs these inputs for verification or an explicitly required rebuild. Retire after that dependency ends.

artifacts.purpose: Default empty container awaiting the first export run.
artifacts.producer: Private companion setup or export execution.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The export workflow creates a run-specific child here.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate the empty container inside the verified PRIVATE companion when needed.

retention_rule.rule: May remain while this companion is configured. Retire only while empty and no export process is using it.
